content:
August is here, with $50 off AirPods Pro 3, $100 off AirPods Max 2, and AirTag 2 all-time low deals still live. But the headline of today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break is the M5 MacBook Air — we found a rare $200 discount on the 24GB/512GB model, but we're also tracking up to $300 off select configurations at the official Apple Certified Refurbished store, including this 24GB 15-inch model (more details here). These deals are also joined by close to $100 off various Apple Watch Ultra 3 configurations, the latest Beats 240W Braided USB-C Cable in black down at just $18, and a chance to grab transparent red Beats Solo Buds for as low as $40. Hit the jump for all the details.

August AirPods deals up to $100 off: AirPods Pro 3, Max 2, more from $99

  • AirPods Pro 3 $200 (originally $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (originally $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (originally $129)
  • AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation $119 (originally $179) — Renewed Premium

Best Buy rolls out August Back to School deals: Apple gear, smart TVs from $80, dorm upgrades, more

Official Apple Refurbished Store now has the lowest prices yet on M5 MacBook Air, up to $300 off

Price hikes on the latest MacBook lineup have now landed at retail, and while we've found plenty of deals up to $500 off, the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is offering some of the best discounts on select M5 MacBook Air configurations. We've already featured the lowest priced base model from a reputable source, but you can also grab this 24GB 15-inch model for $300 below the new pricing in Midnight Black, Silver, Starlight, and Sky Blue.

The official Apple Refurbished Store is now selling the 15-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 24GB of RAM and 1TB of storage for $1,699 (with shipping included). As noted above, this deal applies to all four colors: Midnight Black, Silver, Starlight, and Sky Blue.

This MacBook Air has a new price of $1,900, with all configurations now going for over $1,999 on Amazon.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (originally $1,299) — $200 off
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,359 (originally $1,599) — $240 off
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,699 (originally $1,999) — $300 off

Today's Apple Refurbished Store deals bring this machine back to old pricing and are the best discounts we've tracked since the price hike took effect. Given the current situation, these new MSRPs are likely to stay in place through the end of the year and beyond. So while this isn't the all-time lowest price, for anyone looking to pick up an M5 MacBook Air this year, it's a very worthwhile opportunity to save some cash — and the next MacBook Air lineup isn't likely to hit these prices until mid-2027 or later.

See all MacBook deals at the Apple Refurbished Store here — use the filters on the left side of the page to find the model you want.

Lowest price 15-inch 24GB M5 MacBook Air drops $200 today

Ongoing deal: 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro sees massive $500 discount at Amazon today

MacBook pricing has indeed just gone up, but Amazon is still offering a massive $500 discount on the 24GB/2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro this morning. This price is very close to the best prices we tracked before the price hike took effect. Details below.

Amazon is now selling the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB of RAM and 2TB of storage for $2,499 (with shipping included).

Considering this machine's regular price at Apple and other channels is $2,999, that's a real $500 savings. This deal applies to both Space Black and Silver models.

This is the best deal we've tracked on an M5 Pro model since retailers raised prices.

Before today, Amazon's highest discount on this machine was $300, but it's now an additional $200 off.

While this isn't quite the lowest price we tracked before the price hike, there's nothing we can do about it — after all, we can't go back in time. Considering the size of the price hike roughly a month ago, this deal is only $100 off from our all-time lowest M5 Pro price.

Black and natural titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 models get close to $100 off at Amazon

Update: As expected, Amazon has now also lowered prices on several other Ultra 3 configurations, including the natural titanium case model with Anchor Blue Ocean Band, with close to $100 off. Details below.

While Series 11 has seen steady discounts, as we're seeing now in early August, deals on the Apple Watch Ultra 3 are much rarer. But this morning we spotted Amazon offering the black Ultra 3 with a Black Unity Sport Band, discounted by close to $100.

Amazon is now selling the black titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with matching Black Ocean Band for $699.99 (with shipping included).

The regular price is $799, and this price is close to a $100 discount — the best deal we've found on a new unit from a reputable retailer.

Apart from a brief $150 discount during Amazon Prime Day, this price is on par with this year's best deals and is one of the few significant price drops we've tracked at Amazon.

As of writing, the black model with Ocean Band is the only configuration with a notable discount. But if this deal follows the same pattern as last time, we may well see other color configurations getting price cuts today and throughout the week.

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Black Ocean Band $700 (originally $799)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Anchor Blue Ocean Band $700 (originally $799)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Blue Trail Loop $700 (originally $799)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $800 (originally $899)

If what you want is the Series 11, you can now get it for much less:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (originally $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (originally $429)

Latest Beats 240W Braided USB-C Cable (black) falls back to all-time low of $18 with free Prime shipping (40% off)

Grab transparent red Beats Solo Buds for as low as $41 today

We're very impressed with the built-in battery life of the Solo Buds — currently Beats' most affordable wireless earbuds. But priced at $80 and regularly $70 on Amazon, they're even more attractive if you can get them for $41 (with shipping included) at Best Buy. See all Best Buy Beats deals here, and more Solo Buds deals below.

Best Buy is now selling open-box transparent red Beats Solo Buds in "excellent condition" for $40.99 (with shipping included). That's nearly half the suggested retail price and well below Amazon's $70 new price.

  • Functions and appearance are like new.
  • Includes all parts and accessories. Packaging may vary or may not be provided.

You're choosing a relatively entry-level pair of earbuds, but we're talking about current-generation earbuds from Apple's Beats brand, available for $41.

As mentioned above, in our hands-on testing, this pair of earbuds offers up to 18 hours of listening time on a single charge from the built-in battery. While it's not a wireless charging design with a charging case, for most users, $41 for this kind of battery life is already quite sufficient. Other features include one-touch seamless pairing, custom microphones with advanced noise-learning algorithms for superior call quality, and industry-leading Class 1 Bluetooth.
